# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure money-manager-import (2026-10-22). Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. # Left out on purpose: # - the 401 for an invalid, expired, revoked or other-scope upload token (api/deps.py:116-121) # - rate limits on the route (api/money_manager_upload.py:42-43) # - Cancel on the review card and the force re-import of an up-to-date backup (useMoneyManagerImport.ts:156-168) # - the browser's own 4.5 MB body check before posting (services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:83-85) # - the 500 for OSError, RuntimeError and SQLAlchemyError (api/money_manager_upload.py:81-85) # - a failed analytics refresh: the ledger stays saved and analytics_status is failed (services/money_manager_import.py:124-131) # - normalization, transfer pairing and soft deletes inside the snapshot path (statement-import.yaml draws them) # - the Sync from Money Manager button on the Upload page, which runs the same shortcut on an iPhone or iPad # (pages/upload-sync/components/MoneyManagerShortcutButton.tsx:68, docs/HANDBOOK.md:226-230) # - per-item skip reasons and kept edits of repeat rules and budgets (services/external_ref_sync.py:122-176) # - require_token_scope (api/deps.py:130) guards the MCP and bank-alert routes, not this one: the route takes # get_upload_principal, whose token check defaults to the mmbak:upload scope (services/upload_tokens.py:112) title: Money Manager backup import subtitle: The server reads the .mmbak itself; a dry run fills the review, and only a confirmed or token upload commits kind: flowchart direction: down

svg.title: Money Manager backup import
svg.desc: Money Manager backup import. 22 components in 3 groups. Connections: Money Manager backup to iOS Shortcut (on app close); iOS Shortcut to Body within limit?; Choose a .mmbak to Gzip in the browser; Gzip in the browser to POST dry_run=true; POST dry_run=true to Body within limit?; Review card to POST import (confirm); POST import to Body within limit?; Body within limit? to 413, ledger unchanged (no); Body within limit? to Identify uploader (yes); Identify uploader to Read backup; Read backup to 400, ledger unchanged (unreadable); Read backup to Already imported?; Already imported? to 200 unchanged (yes, not forced); Already imported? to Reconcile, source UID first (no); Reconcile, source UID first to Removes > max(25, 5%)?; Removes > max(25, 5%)? to 409, rolled back (yes); Removes > max(25, 5%)? to Dry run? (no); Dry run? to Review card (yes: 200 preview); Dry run? to Sync repeat rules and budgets (no); Sync repeat rules and budgets to Commit ledger + import log; Commit ledger + import log to Refresh analytics; Refresh analytics to 200 imported.

text.tspan: The server reads the .mmbak itself; a dry run fills the review, and only a confirmed or token upload commits
